title: Prelookup
text: Compute index and fraction for a Curve Using Prelookup or Map Using Prelookup block, 1 input, 1 output, {Targeted Routine} sets AUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement Ifx_DPSearch; {Targeted Routine Library} Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement, {Breakpoints Specification} sets how to enter breakpoint data Explicit, {Breakpoints} sets the breakpoint data values, {Name}, {Index search method} sets the method for searching breakpoint data Linear, {Begin index search using previous index result} sets the start search using the index found at the previous time and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point or floating-point operations. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal, u scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Bus containing output index and fraction Simulink.Bus object

params.name: Targeted Routine Library
params.values: Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement IFX (fixed-point) | IFL (floating-point)

params.name: Targeted Routine
params.values: AUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement Ifx_DPSearch | Ifl_DPSearch

params.name: Breakpoints Specification
params.values: Choose how to enter breakpoint data Explicit values (default) | Breakpoint object

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of a Simulink.Breakpoint object Simulink.Breakpoint object

params.name: Index search method
params.values: Method for searching breakpoint data Linear search (default) | Binary search

params.name: Begin index search using previous index result
params.values: Start search using the index found at the previous time step off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point or floating-point operations Zero (default) | Round
